messages.body:
Здравствуйте, Виктор!

Записала для вас короткое видео: год после покупки — хороший момент посмотреть, всё ли работает на вас. Три минуты, без обязательств.

[Video: Годовой обзор]

Em gửi một video ngắn cảm ơn anh đã tin tưởng giới thiệu khách. Em cũng chia sẻ nhanh tình hình hồ sơ để anh tiện theo dõi.

conversations.subject: Un mensaje rápido sobre sus documentos

messages.body:
Hola María,

Le grabé un video corto explicando exactamente qué documentos faltan y cómo enviarlos desde su teléfono — a veces es más fácil verlo que leerlo.

[Video: Cómo enviar sus documentos]

If the video doesn't load, use this link instead.

Hi everyone,

I recorded a short update on what we're seeing this month — inventory, buyer activity, and what it means if you're waiting to make a move.

[Video: July market update]

If the video doesn't load, use this link instead.

Hi Thanh,

You're clear to close. The signing is set for Thursday at 8:00 AM at Chicago Title in Renton.

Bring a government photo ID. There's nothing else you need to do before then.

Minh Nguyen
NMLS 1856432
Company NMLS 320841

Equal Housing Opportunity.

Cảm ơn anh Minh. Tôi sẽ đến lúc 8 giờ.

One question — my rate lock expires Friday. Is that a problem if we sign Thursday?

conversations.subject: Hồ sơ của anh chị đã được duyệt có điều kiện

messages.body:
Chào anh chị,

Tin vui — hồ sơ vay đã được duyệt có điều kiện. Ngân hàng chỉ cần thêm:

• Giấy xác nhận việc làm mới nhất
• Sao kê tài khoản tháng 6

Em sẽ gọi chiều nay để giải thích rõ hơn.

Thúy Phạm
NMLS 1901288
Company NMLS 320841

Cơ hội Nhà ở Bình đẳng.
messages.translationEn: Good news — your loan file has been conditionally approved. The lender only needs a current employment verification and your June bank statement. I'll call this afternoon to explain.

messages.body: Cảm ơn em Thúy nhiều lắm! Anh sẽ xin giấy xác nhận ngày mai. Gọi sau 5 giờ nhé, giờ đó anh mới xong việc.
messages.translationEn: Thank you so much, Thúy! I'll request the verification letter tomorrow. Please call after 5 — I finish work then.

messages.body: Minh — my wife asked whether the appraisal has come back yet. Also, do we need to do anything about the VOE you mentioned?

Hola,

Gracias por su tiempo hoy. Para avanzar con la preaprobación necesito:

• Talones de pago de las últimas 2 quincenas
• W-2 de 2024
• Estados de cuenta bancarios de 2 meses

Puede enviarlos por foto desde su teléfono si es más fácil.

Carlos Mendoza
NMLS 1764201
Company NMLS 320841

Igualdad de Oportunidades en la Vivienda.
messages.translationEn: Hello — thank you for your time today. To move forward with the preapproval I need: pay stubs for the last two pay periods, your 2024 W-2, and two months of bank statements. Photos from your phone are fine.

messages.body: Gracias Carlos. Mando todo el viernes cuando me paguen. ¿El W-2 lo puede sacar mi esposa de su portal del trabajo?
messages.translationEn: Thank you Carlos. I'll send everything Friday when I get paid. Can my wife pull the W-2 from her work portal?

messages.body:
Здравствуйте!

Спасибо за разговор сегодня. Чтобы двигаться дальше, мне нужны:

• Справки о зарплате за последние два месяца
• Выписки с банковского счёта за 60 дней

Если удобнее, можно прислать фотографии документов.

Elena Petrova
NMLS 1922845
Company NMLS 320841

Равные жилищные возможности.
messages.translationEn: Hello! Thank you for the conversation today. To move forward I need pay statements for the last two months and 60 days of bank statements. Photos of the documents are fine.

messages.body: Елена, добрый день! Документы соберу к понедельнику. Один вопрос — если жена не работает, это повлияет на одобрение?
messages.translationEn: Elena, good afternoon! I'll gather the documents by Monday. One question — if my wife doesn't work, will that affect the approval?

messages.body: Hi Denise — underwriting asked for a short note explaining the $8,400 deposit on 6/28. A sentence or two is enough. — Minh, Loan Factory
That was the sale of my old car. I'll write it up tonight.
Hi Minh — sending you Grace Kim. She's pre-shopping, wants to know her number before we tour. Be gentle, she's nervous about the whole thing.

Got her, thanks Jenna. I'll call today and keep it low-pressure.

Minh

Chào chị Bích,

We're close. To finish the review I still need:

- Your last 2 business bank statements
- The 2025 profit and loss statement

You can send them however is easiest.

Minh Nguyen
NMLS 1856432
Anh Minh, tôi sẽ gửi tuần này. Tiệm đang bận quá.

Erin — congratulations. Your loan funded and the home is officially yours.

It was a pleasure working with you and Dan. If anything comes up, you know where to find me.

Minh Nguyen
NMLS 1856432
Company NMLS 320841

Equal Housing Opportunity.
Called to check on the house search. No answer — left a voicemail.

approvals.title: Реактивация: Виктор Лебедев — год после закрытия
approvals.body:
Здравствуйте, Виктор!

Прошёл год с покупки вашего дома — поздравляю с годовщиной!

Раз в год я предлагаю клиентам короткий разговор: посмотреть, изменилось ли что-то, и стоит ли что-то предпринять. Без обязательств. Удобно ли на следующей неделе?

Elena Petrova
NMLS 1922845
Company NMLS 320841

Равные жилищные возможности.

Khi nào anh gửi được, em xem ngay và báo bước tiếp theo.

Cơ hội Nhà ở Bình đẳng.

approvals.title: Seguimiento a María García — documentos pendientes
approvals.body:
Hola María,

Solo un recordatorio amable: todavía esperamos sus talones de pago y los estados de cuenta para completar la preaprobación.

Cuando los tenga, respóndame a este correo y yo me encargo del resto.

Carlos Mendoza
NMLS 1764201
Company NMLS 320841

Igualdad de Oportunidades en la Vivienda.
approvals.rationale: Documents were requested 5 days ago with no reply. Her preferred language is Spanish. English translation shown to you; the Spanish text is what would send.

approvals.title: Diego Alvarez has gone quiet — 9 days with no movement
approvals.rationale: Preapproved at $430K five weeks ago and searching, but there's been no activity for 9 days and his preapproval expires in about a month.

approvals.title: Annual review outreach — Paul Whitmore
approvals.body:
Hi Paul,

It's been a year since you closed on the Magnolia house — congratulations on the anniversary.

I set aside time each year to look at my clients' mortgages and check whether anything has changed worth acting on. No agenda, and no cost. Would a 15-minute call in the next week or two be useful?

Minh Nguyen
NMLS 1856432
Company NMLS 320841

Equal Housing Opportunity.
approvals.rationale: His loan closed 358 days ago and his annual review date has arrived. No contact in 96 days.

approvals.title: Call Chidi Okonkwo — rate alert lead, no contact for 26 hours
approvals.rationale: He set a rate alert through the QM Pricer 26 hours ago and nobody has called. Leads contacted within an hour convert several times more often than leads contacted the next day.
factors: Captured 26 hours ago via QM Pricer

approvals.title: Reply to Quang Lê — he asked about the appraisal
approvals.body:
Hi Quang,

The appraisal is ordered and we're waiting on the report — I'll call you the moment it lands.

On the VOE: your employer switched payroll providers, so the first request bounced. I've sent a new one. Nothing needed from you.

Minh Nguyen
NMLS 1856432
Company NMLS 320841

Equal Housing Opportunity.
approvals.rationale: He asked two direct questions 5 hours ago and hasn't had a reply. The file also has an open VOE task that's 2 days overdue.
factors: Open task overdue 2 days on the same file
File in Processing, no movement 6 days

approvals.title: Reminder to Bích Trần — bank statements still outstanding
approvals.body:
Chào chị Bích,

Em viết thư này để nhắc chị về hai bảng sao kê ngân hàng và báo cáo lãi lỗ năm 2025.

Khi nào chị gửi được, em sẽ xem lại ngay và cho chị biết bước tiếp theo.

Minh Nguyen
NMLS 1856432
Company NMLS 320841

Equal Housing Opportunity.
approvals.rationale: Documents were flagged 4 days ago and she replied that the salon is busy. No reminder has gone out since. Her preferred language is Vietnamese.
factors: No reminder sent since the flag was raised
